script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sports
Theme: friendship

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. LOS ANGELES HIGH SCHOOL - GYM - DAY

COACH JAMES (40s, passionate) leads a group of STUDENTS (15-18) through a grueling workout.

COACH JAMES
(yelling)
One more rep! Push through the pain!

The room echoes with the clanging of weights and grunts of effort. Suddenly, a new STUDENT, MIKE (16, shy), enters. The other students turn to look.

COACH JAMES
(to Mike)
You're late. Find a spot and join in.

Mike hesitates, then makes his way to the far corner of the room. He sets up his mat and begins to copy the movements of those around him.

INT. LOS ANGELES HIGH SCHOOL - CAFETERIA - LUNCHTIME

Mike sits alone at a table, eating a sandwich. Suddenly, JESS (17, popular, athletic) approaches.

JESS
(smirking)
New guy, huh? I'm Jess. You're Mike, right?

MIKE
(nervously)
Yes. Hi.

Jess laughs and sits down across from Mike.

JESS
You know, I was a bit worried about you. You look like you could use a friend.

MIKE
(surprised)
I... I don't know many people here.

Jess smiles and reaches out a hand.

JESS
Well, consider me your friend.

INT. LOS ANGELES HIGH SCHOOL - GYM - EVENING

Coach James gathers the students together.

COACH JAMES
(serious)
I have some news. Our school is hosting the city-wide wrestling tournament next month. We're going to compete.

The room fills with excitement and nervousness. Mike looks at Jess, who gives him a reassuring nod.

INT. LOS ANGELES HIGH SCHOOL - GYM - DAY

Mike and Jess practice together, Mike looking up to Jess for guidance. They push each other, encourage each other, and form a strong bond.

INT. LOS ANGELES HIGH SCHOOL - GYM - NIGHT

The night before the tournament, the students are restless. Mike is particularly anxious.

MIKE
(to Jess)
I don't think I can do this. I'm not good enough.

Jess puts a comforting hand on Mike's shoulder.

JESS
(smiling)
You're stronger than you think. You just need to believe in yourself.

INT. LOS ANGELES HIGH SCHOOL - GYM - DAY

The day of the tournament arrives. Mike competes bravely, relying on the lessons and encouragement he received from Jess and Coach James.

INT. LOS ANGELES HIGH SCHOOL - GYM - EVENING

The tournament concludes, and the team gathers to celebrate their hard work. Mike is presented with an award for his determination and improvement.

Coach James looks on proudly, and Jess beams with pride. They've all accomplished something great, and they've done it together.

FADE OUT.
